title: Hot Stamping Foil for Matte Laminated Paper

seo.title: Hot Stamping Foil for Matte Laminated Paper

content:
Matte laminated paper gives paper boxes a soft and premium surface, but it is harder for hot stamping foil than ordinary paper.

## Why It Is Difficult

The top surface is a film layer, not paper fiber. Standard paper foil may transfer at first but show weak adhesion during handling or folding. For this reason, the final laminated sheet should always be tested.

## How to Choose

Use a foil grade made for laminated paper. Check small text, fine lines, the brand logo and one solid area. If the foil peels, a stronger surface-compatible grade may be needed.

## Process Advice

Adjust temperature and pressure gradually. If the setting is too weak, transfer may be incomplete. If the setting is too strong, edges may look unclear.

## FAQ

### Can standard paper foil work on matte lamination?

Sometimes, but a laminated-surface foil is usually safer.

### What should I test?

Check adhesion, rub resistance, folding performance and edge clarity.
